In `parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, a parse failure results in throwing `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` without including the Zod error details or the raw Microsoft response. This is a verifiable regression in diagnostics/observability (harder to debug token refresh failures), but it does not by itself prove a functional correctness defect.
